entries.reason: A seed counts only when the routine spares at least this much need above the threshold, in need-thousandths times minutes, against waiting. Measured before any model was asked, on the eight development seeds over the starter world's small square and its eight people, through the product's own comparison runner with a scripted model (scripts/measure_society_comparison.py anchors): the routine spared from 10,858 to 25,175, median 18,537.5. A quarter of the median, rounded down to the hundred, so no seed that counts weighs more than four times the median seed in a mean. A seed under it is excluded by name, never scored.

entries.reason: The most people a comparison runs. A run is replayed from its receipts whenever it is read, and the page reads two runs at once: replaying one run of eight people for the hour through the run route took from 163 to 462 ms on the development machine (scripts/measure_society_comparison.py anchors). Eight is a saved world's own population; a larger society is refused by name rather than read slowly.
